mapper.insert: insert into event_raw ( trace_id, event_type, symbol, exchange_code, payload_json, created_at ) values ( #{traceId}, #{eventType}, #{symbol}, #{exchangeCode}, #{payloadJson}, coalesce(#{createdAt}, current_timestamp) )
insert into market_event ( trace_id, symbol, exchange_code, price, volume ) values ( #{traceId}, #{symbol}, #{exchangeCode}, #{price}, #{volume} )

insert into market_kline_snapshot ( trace_id, symbol, exchange_code, interval_code, open_time, close_time, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, quote_volume, trade_count, source, payload_json ) values ( #{traceId}, #{symbol}, #{exchangeCode}, #{intervalCode}, #{openTime}, #{closeTime}, #{openPrice}, #{highPrice}, #{lowPrice}, #{closePrice}, #{volume}, #{quoteVolume}, #{tradeCount}, #{source}, #{payloadJson} )

insert into market_metric_snapshot ( trace_id, symbol, exchange_code, observed_at, latest_price, mark_price, mark_price_deviation_pct, funding_rate, open_interest, volume_24h, quote_volume_24h, liquidation_notional_15m, liquidation_notional_60m, liquidation_notional_240m, largest_liquidation_notional_usd, largest_liquidation_side, source_status, payload_json ) values ( #{traceId}, #{symbol}, #{exchangeCode}, #{observedAt}, #{latestPrice}, #{markPrice}, #{markPriceDeviationPct}, #{fundingRate}, #{openInterest}, #{volume24h}, #{quoteVolume24h}, #{liquidationNotional15m}, #{liquidationNotional60m}, #{liquidationNotional240m}, #{largestLiquidationNotionalUsd}, #{largestLiquidationSide}, #{sourceStatus}, #{payloadJson} )
insert into news_event ( trace_id, symbol, source, headline ) values ( #{traceId}, #{symbol}, #{source}, #{headline} )
insert into onchain_event ( trace_id, symbol, wallet, payload_json ) values ( #{traceId}, #{symbol}, #{wallet}, #{payloadJson} )
insert into social_event ( trace_id, symbol, score, payload_json ) values ( #{traceId}, #{symbol}, #{score}, #{payloadJson} )
mapper.select: select id, trace_id as traceId, event_type as eventType, symbol, exchange_code as exchangeCode, payload_json as payloadJson, created_at as createdAt from event_raw where event_type in ('market_tick', 'market_metric') and symbol = #{symbol} and exchange_code = #{exchangeCode} and created_at >= #{createdAtMin} order by created_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}
